description: Read-only impact.com Partner Catalogs API. Direct Partner API reads return partner-eligible catalog items, tracking URLs, consumer current/list prices, currency, and stock. This is an affiliate catalog, not a wholesale dropship supplier service.

capabilities.title: Search partner-visible catalog products by keyword and documented filter
capabilities.blocker: Client code is present; live replay needs an authorized Partner Account SID/Auth Token with Catalog read scope and at least one visible catalog. No such credentials were supplied.

capabilities.title: Read one catalog item by catalog ID and item ID
capabilities.blocker: The official Partner detail route and identity fields are documented. Live data requires an authorized partner token plus a catalog/item visible to that account.

capabilities.title: Collect current consumer price, original price, currency, discount, and stock status
capabilities.blocker: Schema mapping is implemented and fixture-tested; the current price and inventory values have not been independently replayed for an authorized Impact partner account.

capabilities.title: Read search results using the documented 1-based Page and PageSize parameters
capabilities.note: The API documents Page as 1-based and PageSize default 100. The response schema does not document a total count/next-page marker, so the client returns continuation as possible or unknown rather than claiming complete traversal.
capabilities.blocker: No live partner response has established account-specific page behavior or a full-feed stopping condition.

capabilities.title: List partner-visible product catalogs and metadata
capabilities.note: Credential-bearing FTPLocations and download-location fields are deliberately discarded from result objects.
capabilities.blocker: Requires an authorized Partner API token with Catalog read access.

capabilities.title: Return item categories included in each catalog result
capabilities.note: Item Category/SubCategory values are merchant/catalog supplied; a complete taxonomy endpoint is not claimed.
capabilities.blocker: No authorized live partner catalog was available to inspect category coverage.

capabilities.title: Interactive impact.com login flow
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This task implements only the documented Partner API HTTP Basic read client; browser login and token issuance are outside this scope. An Account SID/Auth Token with Catalog read scope are still required.

capabilities.title: Read dropshipping supplier acquisition cost or fulfillment terms
capabilities.applicabilityReason: The current documented Partner Item model exposes consumer CurrentPrice/OriginalPrice, stock, and shipping fields. It does not expose partner wholesale acquisition cost, supplier checkout, or fulfillment terms.

capabilities.title: Apply to a brand program or create/update an affiliate link
capabilities.applicabilityReason: This service adapter is scoped to read-only product discovery and price collection; program applications and link writes are outside it.
